title: Temperature
description: Class 5 IMO — Temperature: reading a thermometer in degrees Celsius, finding the difference between temperatures, and simple rise-and-fall word problems.

topics.title: Reading a Thermometer (°C)
topics.concept:
Temperature is measured with a thermometer in degrees Celsius (°C). Water freezes at 0°C and boils at 100°C. Normal body temperature is about 37°C.

The higher the number, the hotter it is; the lower the number, the colder it is.

examples.problem: At what temperature does water boil?
At what temperature does water freeze?

recap: Temperature is measured in degrees Celsius (°C).
Water freezes at 0°C and boils at 100°C; body ≈ 37°C.

topics.title: Difference in Temperature
topics.concept: The difference between two temperatures is found by subtracting the lower from the higher. If it is 35°C in the afternoon and 20°C at night, the difference is 35 − 20 = 15°C.

examples.problem: The temperature goes from 5°C to 25°C. By how much did it rise?

recap: A rise increases the temperature; a fall decreases it.

quiz.q: What is the difference between 40°C and 28°C?

topics.title: Rise & Fall Problems
topics.concept: When the temperature rises, add the change; when it falls, subtract it. If it is 25°C and falls by 10°C, the new temperature is 25 − 10 = 15°C.

examples.problem: The temperature is 25°C and falls by 10°C. What is the new temperature?
The temperature is 18°C and rises by 7°C. What is the new temperature?

recap: Rise: add the change. Fall: subtract the change.

quiz.q: The temperature is 20°C and rises by 5°C. What is it now?
The temperature is 12°C and falls by 4°C. What is it now?

questions.explanation: Temperature is measured in degrees Celsius (°C).
5°C is the lower number, so it is colder.
